Package logic.game

Class GameEngine

java.lang.Object
logic.game.GameEngine
public class GameEngine extends Object
Core game engine that orchestrates player movement, combat, item pickup, obstacle pushing, and win/lose condition checks for a single level. Delegates board state to GameBoard and session state to GameSession.
